name: PawBench
intro: PawBench 是面向 Agentic AI 的 Model × Harness 联合评测基准。固定 v1.0 仓库树包含 150 个任务、9 个模型与 3 套 Harness，共形成 4,050 个配置任务单元；项目尚无独立论文，因此官方固定仓库与项目网站是主要方法来源。
build_method: Reuse & Tag, 统一任务合同, Model × Harness联合运行
metric: Overall score, Slice scores, Harness gap
modality: 文本, 多模态, 工具
task_type: Agent任务, Harness评估, 工具调用
eval_feature: 6类任务来源, 5维正交标签, 3种评分模式, Model × Harness共评估, 诊断trace
scale: 150个任务, 9个模型, 3个Harness, 27组提交, 4,050个配置任务单元, 6类任务来源
task_type_en: Agent task, Harness evaluation, Tool use
build_method_en: Reuse and Tag, unified task contracts, Model × Harness execution
eval_feature_en: Six task sources, five orthogonal tags, three grading modes, Model × Harness co-evaluation, diagnostic traces
intro_en: PawBench is a Model × Harness co-evaluation benchmark for agentic AI. Its pinned v1.0 tree contains 150 tasks, 9 models, and 3 harnesses, forming 4,050 configured task cells. No standalone paper is published, so the fixed official repository and project site are the primary methodology sources.
scale_en: 150 tasks, 9 models, 3 harnesses, 27 submissions, 4,050 configured task cells, 6 task sources
metric_en: Overall score, Slice scores, Harness gap

drawio_review_note: reviewed_at=2026-07-22; scope=source-stage repository-level Build Process reconstruction for PawBench v1.0; project-site=https://agentscope-ai.github.io/PawBench/; official-code-pin=https://github.com/agentscope-ai/PawBench/tree/0f794a8bb6c27aa9ee4091b2691fa30e4ed9cc8f; fixed-git-commit=0f794a8bb6c27aa9ee4091b2691fa30e4ed9cc8f. No standalone paper, arXiv preprint, DOI, or paper PDF is published in the pinned repository or project site. The official repository and project site are therefore the primary methodology sources; the graph does not manufacture a paper citation. The GitHub repository reports no tags and no GitHub releases at the fixed review point, so the full commit is the immutable release pin rather than a guessed v1.0 tag. Fixed file evidence: README.md sha256=e8a4267d38002f668f68bbfa7019286aad4af91e631be2f08e2eb86a17357da8; README.zh-CN.md sha256=a090f887a72aaacdccc9be975b58f0a5e0585fd61bf3a4defbe7a1b50a01d03c; LICENSE sha256=54db3cdb97f452dbc0501754370afc4a5c6d014bd626b358bf6ac680a733c514; pawbench/task_loader.py sha256=82d5f386386b756c5764c8f2c2890df0d7d6af370ad2119bf40c0c80146b4a50; pawbench/backend.py sha256=7d0a9e366b2145cf05e753dbdbea81a61fe8ef6e1afab378a17b4620e3d7e9e0; pawbench/grader.py sha256=a6972378d001904cb03cdb0c59724d9305675c743a1391e32b256d3105d67377; run_bench.py sha256=d0d29b619195638e1f3721c08a5a549b7ff0dbddec46c880ecfefc473003f703; site/scripts/aggregate_results.py sha256=450b4c1b09e924c6f15615afa8aa3a21c5ab1f67aa95d8dbcce8135ab0997147; site/scripts/build_tasks.py sha256=1886ff41b22b3a503200955598d26655d4da9700d564c9b82d9746e5d56a57a8. The fixed 150 task Markdown files were enumerated and individually hashed in filename order; the resulting task tree digest is b90ac4523b146d0fdca632bb3dbd16549c817e22a218a898a08a5bb4ae443685. All 150 front-matter task IDs are unique. The fixed source distribution exactly matches the official Reuse & Tag table: 52 claweval tasks, 29 qwenclawbench tasks, 23 pinchbench tasks, 21 qwenpawbench/self-built tasks, 15 skillsbench tasks, and 10 wildclawbench tasks. The graph does not rename qwenpawbench filenames into a seventh source; it records the repository table's self-built label and preserves the task-tree evidence. Construction begins from the repository's explicit claim that agent performance is a function of both Model and Harness. PawBench therefore treats Model × Harness × Task as the co-evaluation unit and holds the task definition fixed while changing the runtime or model. Reuse & Tag normalizes upstream tasks into one Markdown plus YAML-front-matter representation. Each task discloses an ID, name, category, grading type, timeout, workspace files, prompt, expected behavior, grading criteria, optional embedded automated checker, optional LLM-judge rubric, optional grading weights, and the five-label taxonomy. The five dimensions are scenario, capabilities, complexity, modality, and environment. The fixed tree contains 109 L3, 29 L2, and 12 L1 tasks; 129 closed and 21 open-environment tasks; and 124 text plus 26 multimodal tasks. These counts document the fixed tree rather than adding undisclosed selection stages. Grading modes are also enumerated from the fixed front matter: 120 hybrid, 15 automated, and 15 llm_judge tasks. Harness reproducibility is pinned from the three fixed Dockerfiles. QwenPaw uses version 1.1.3 in docker/Dockerfile.pawbench-qwenpaw, sha256=c6284efa71e5c66f5c4f66d445e83717cc4982bad0fdfa448f45a93bd921c11f. OpenClaw uses version 2026.4.24 in docker/Dockerfile.pawbench-openclaw, sha256=6914fec7c98cb940d36ba03210566226b1de9e84f52fd2aa661a061cb2d508f0. Hermes uses version 2026.4.23 in docker/Dockerfile.pawbench-hermes, sha256=fd3ac589988e14cba84c96c6e8629af032a4bc7c96562f4708bc66505c1cf557. The Dockerfiles pin the agent package versions but still install operating-system and Python dependencies through package repositories; this is a reproducibility boundary and not evidence for hidden immutable container digests. The official baseline crosses 9 models with QwenPaw, OpenClaw, and Hermes on the same 150 tasks, yielding 27 model-harness submissions and 4,050 configured task cells. The fixed submission snapshot is dated May 29 2026. A representative pinned file, pawbench-4models-opusjudge-20260529__qwen3.6-plus__qwenpaw.json, has sha256=0c83a96c0b03955850032de66b8796e4aedbd75258e7d4e1e29104f7d08a505e. Published scores are outputs of this snapshot and are not used as construction requirements. Execution semantics come from the fixed runner and backend. The selected Docker harness starts an isolated standard workspace, clears residual top-level files, creates output and sessions directories, and stages only each task's declared workspace files after safe-path checks. The selected adapter receives the task-specific prompt, runs under the task's own timeout multiplied by any explicit runtime multiplier, and exposes a common transcript and result contract. The backend collects the full workspace and output files, extracts the harness transcript, records status, elapsed time, usage, stdout, and known logs, then grades the collected outcome. Optional flags preserve the final workspace or Docker image for deeper replay. Retry and anomaly handling are runner behavior, not a new task-selection pass. Automated grading extracts the Python grade function embedded in the task Markdown, executes task-specific checks against transcript and workspace, normalizes numeric criterion scores, and averages them. LLM-judge grading builds a strict grading prompt from the public task prompt, expected behavior, task rubric or criteria, and a bounded transcript summary; it requests exactly one JSON object with per-criterion scores, total, and notes. Hybrid grading applies each task's declared automated and LLM weights, defaulting to equal weights only when a task omits them. The fixed code sets AUTO_PENALTY_THRESHOLD to 0.75: when automated score is below that threshold, the LLM contribution is normally zeroed so a judge cannot rescue a failed artifact. Only detected mid-run API interruption classes allow the simple weighted score to survive; empty-transcript and zero-token anomalies do not. Scores remain on 0 to 1 and a task passes only at a perfect score. Aggregation averages task outcomes per model-harness submission, counts errors and missing tasks as zero, keeps automated and judge partitions, and builds slices by source, scenario, top-level scenario, capability, complexity, modality, channel, environment, category, subcategory, and grading type. The diagnostic interpretation is explicit: fix a model to compare harnesses, fix a harness to compare models, then inspect failed graders, transcripts, and optional workspace artifacts. Judge-version drift is not hidden. The fixed README says the published baseline uses claude opus 4.6 as judge. The pinned grader instead defines DEFAULT_JUDGE_MODEL='claude-opus-4-5-20251101', and run_bench.py permits --judge or JUDGE_MODEL to override it. The submission JSON stores aggregate judge scores but does not independently prove the provider-side checkpoint for each request. The diagram therefore labels README baseline: Claude Opus 4.6, code default: 4-5-20251101, and runtime override as distinct facts. It does not assert that every historical row was judged by the code default. Prompt and parser boundaries are likewise explicit. Task prompts, expected behaviors, checker code, grading criteria, and LLM rubrics are public per task. There is no single global inference prompt because each harness adapter runs the task prompt through its own runtime. There is no common answer parser because automated tasks execute task-specific checker code and LLM judging parses one required JSON score object. No global inference prompt, answer parser, hidden judge checkpoint, provider endpoint, credential, model decoding policy, or undisclosed harness prompt was invented. Comparability is a contract rather than an identity claim: the README requires harness contributions to preserve the same task prompt, workspace contract, timeout behavior, transcript format, and result schema, while adapters and internal harness behavior remain different by design. Licensing is bounded. The PawBench repository is Apache-2.0; reused tasks retain their source provenance, and external task assets remain subject to upstream rights. The graph does not extend Apache-2.0 to every third-party artifact. Solid edges encode disclosed construction, execution, scoring, aggregation, slicing, diagnosis, and fixed snapshot publication. Dashed edges encode the absence of a standalone paper, the commit-based no-tag release pin, public per-task prompt/parser boundaries, harness compatibility, judge-version drift, and license/provenance. Formal drawio, arch, SVG, PNG generation, fallback synchronization, manifest registration, and site publication are deliberately outside this source-stage handoff. Formal publication evidence [site-a12d-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 4634×1065 (English) and 4629×1065 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 4632×1063 and 4627×1063. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
